prompts.paint-tank: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated 3D modeling reference for an industrial miniature game. Primary request: ONE compact paint supply tank with a small attached pump, believable metal construction, broad clean shapes suited to a 4000-triangle game model. Body proportions X width 1.2, Y height 1.4, Z depth 1.0. Vertical cylindrical teal enamel tank with gently rounded lid, a small warm safety-yellow pump fixed low on its RIGHT side. A single short thick STEEL OUTLET PIPE projects horizontally to the RIGHT (+X), its open round end clearly visible; no long hoses. Tank and pump are one compact assembly on two small integral feet. Style: gently aged industrial B, desaturated turquoise/teal painted metal, warm ochre safety yellow, brushed dark steel edging, subtle edge wear, softly bevelled solid forms, realistic engineering, no cartoon face. Composition: three-quarter view from slightly above, showing front and right outlet, whole object centred with generous white margins. Pure white background, no shadow cast on background. Neutral soft studio light, evenly readable color. Constraints: object only, no floor plane, no square game base plate, no conveyor, wires, cables, liquid, spray, extra cans, safety railing, labels, text, numbers, arrows, logos, dimension marks or decorative props. No skinny fragile parts. Outlet axis horizontal and perpendicular to the right side.
prompts.paint-booth: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated 3D modeling reference for an industrial miniature game.
